name: Google Workspace
description: Use UC San Diego Google Drive, Gmail, and Calendar through fixed, bounded tools.

capabilities.description: Read the connected Google account identity and hosted domain.
Search and read accessible Drive metadata and bounded file content. Cannot create, edit, move, share, or delete files.
Create folders and files, replace file content, rename items, edit Docs and Slides text and slides, and write literal Sheets values. Moving, trashing, deleting, and sharing are separate permissions.
Move items between folders, move items to the trash, and restore them from the trash. Cannot permanently delete or share.
Permanently delete items, bypassing the trash. Deleted items cannot be restored.
List, add, change, and remove sharing for users, groups, domains, or anyone with the link. Cannot transfer ownership.
Search and read messages, threads, labels, and bounded attachments. Cannot send, delete, move, archive, mark, or label messages.
Create unsent plain-text drafts. Cannot send mail or add attachments.
List calendars and read bounded event ranges and exact event details.
Create or narrowly edit calendar events without sending invitations. Cannot delete, respond to invitations, change ownership, or manage calendar access.

tools.name: googleworkspace.identity.get
tools.description: Read the connected UC San Diego Google account identity and hosted domain.

tools.name: googleworkspace.drive.search
tools.description: Search accessible Drive items using bounded structured filters.

tools.name: googleworkspace.drive.item.get
tools.description: Read metadata for one exact accessible Drive item.

tools.name: googleworkspace.drive.content.get
tools.description: Download or export bounded content for one exact accessible Drive item.

tools.name: googleworkspace.docs.get
tools.description: Read one exact Google Docs document through the fixed Docs endpoint.

tools.name: googleworkspace.sheets.get
tools.description: Read one exact Google Sheets spreadsheet or bounded A1 range.

tools.name: googleworkspace.slides.get
tools.description: Read one exact Google Slides presentation through the fixed Slides endpoint.

tools.name: googleworkspace.drive.folder.create
tools.description: Create one Drive folder in My Drive or an exact parent folder.

tools.name: googleworkspace.drive.file.create
tools.description: Create one bounded Drive file, optionally as a native Google Doc, Sheet, or Slides file.

tools.name: googleworkspace.drive.file.update
tools.description: Replace the content of one exact uploaded (non-native) Drive file as a new revision.

tools.name: googleworkspace.drive.item.update
tools.description: Rename or update the description of one exact Drive item.

tools.name: googleworkspace.docs.text.append
tools.description: Append plain text to the end of one exact Google Doc.

tools.name: googleworkspace.docs.text.replace
tools.description: Replace every match of exact text in one Google Doc.

tools.name: googleworkspace.sheets.values.update
tools.description: Overwrite one bounded A1 range with literal values.

tools.name: googleworkspace.sheets.values.append
tools.description: Append literal rows after the table in one A1 range.

tools.name: googleworkspace.slides.text.replace
tools.description: Replace every match of exact text in one presentation.

tools.name: googleworkspace.slides.text.insert
tools.description: Insert plain text into one exact shape on a slide.

tools.name: googleworkspace.slides.slide.create
tools.description: Add one slide with a predefined layout to a presentation.

tools.name: googleworkspace.slides.object.delete
tools.description: Delete one exact slide or page element from a presentation.

tools.name: googleworkspace.drive.item.move
tools.description: Move one exact Drive item into another folder.

tools.name: googleworkspace.drive.item.trash
tools.description: Move one exact Drive item to the trash.

tools.name: googleworkspace.drive.item.restore
tools.description: Restore one exact Drive item from the trash.

tools.name: googleworkspace.drive.item.delete
tools.description: Permanently delete one exact Drive item, bypassing the trash.

tools.name: googleworkspace.drive.permissions.list
tools.description: List sharing permissions on one exact Drive item.

tools.name: googleworkspace.drive.permission.create
tools.description: Share one exact Drive item with a user, group, domain, or anyone with the link.

tools.name: googleworkspace.drive.permission.update
tools.description: Change the role of one exact sharing permission.

tools.name: googleworkspace.drive.permission.delete
tools.description: Remove one exact sharing permission from a Drive item.

tools.name: googleworkspace.mail.search
tools.description: Search Gmail messages using bounded structured filters.

tools.name: googleworkspace.mail.message.get
tools.description: Read one exact Gmail message with bounded body and attachment metadata.

tools.name: googleworkspace.mail.thread.get
tools.description: Read one exact Gmail thread with bounded messages and bodies.

tools.name: googleworkspace.mail.labels.list
tools.description: List bounded Gmail label metadata.

tools.name: googleworkspace.mail.attachment.get
tools.description: Read one exact Gmail attachment within a five-megabyte response ceiling.

tools.name: googleworkspace.mail.draft.create
tools.description: Create one unsent plain-text Gmail draft without attachments.

tools.name: googleworkspace.calendar.list
tools.description: List bounded metadata for calendars available to the connected account.

tools.name: googleworkspace.calendar.events.list
tools.description: List events from one calendar in a bounded timestamp range.

tools.name: googleworkspace.calendar.event.get
tools.description: Read one exact Google Calendar event, including meeting and attachment metadata when available.

tools.name: googleworkspace.calendar.event.create
tools.description: Create one event without attendees, invitations, or conference provisioning.

tools.name: googleworkspace.calendar.event.update
tools.description: Narrowly edit one event without deleting it or changing attendees, ownership, responses, or calendar access.

skills.name: google-drive
skills.description: Search, read, create, edit, organize, delete, or share UC San Diego Google Drive, Docs, Sheets, or Slides through TritonAI Harness. Use when the user asks to find, inspect, change, move, remove, or share Workspace files.

skills.name: gmail
skills.description: Search or read UC San Diego Gmail, or create an unsent plain-text draft through TritonAI Harness. Use when the user asks to inspect mail or prepare a draft without sending it.

skills.name: google-calendar
skills.description: Read, create, or narrowly edit UC San Diego Google Calendar events through TritonAI Harness. Use when the user asks about their schedule or requests an event change.
